# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About לוי דויד
Levi David is a professional videographer and video editor specializing in capturing life's most meaningful celebrations — weddings, bar mitzvahs, and bat mitzvahs. His work focuses on preserving emotional, once-in-a-lifetime moments through cinematic storytelling and professional editing. The brand centers around personal milestones, family memories, and the joy of Jewish lifecycle events.
